title: Uncut Countdown — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Expand around one clock
scenes.purpose: One fixed clock counts down from 02.20 while four synchronised views expand out of it and develop the idea (spark, pair, links).
visuals: Fixed dark clock disc at left with tabular digits, ordinary ticks and a separate bright trigger marker
Four white views fly out of the clock into a 2x2 grid with same-position labels and a shared clock bar
Dashed connectors tie every view to the clock

beats.development: Clock counts down; views 01–04 expand from the clock in a stagger; spark bulb draws.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Pair and links views draw; outcome view shows a faint waiting outline as every shared bar approaches the trigger tick.
captions: Every view runs on the same clock — the outcome view lights up at zero.

scenes.title: Trigger and converge on the outcome
scenes.purpose: At zero the trigger fires once; the outcome network connects, other views converge into the clock and the outcome view grows large and readable.
visuals: Trigger pulse ring and marker accent
SYSTEM view network draws in the active colour
Views 01–03 shrink back into the clock; SYSTEM view scales to hero size

beats.development: Clock reads 00.00 ZERO / CONNECTED; system network connects; other views converge into the clock while the outcome view enlarges.
Settled hold on clock at zero and the large connected-system view.

findings: Brisk 3-second preview: expansion in the first second, trigger at 2.2 s, settled by 2.65 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.65–3.0 s settled hold for reading the outcome and the zero clock.

notes: STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the primary characteristic action (expand to synchronised views, converge on the outcome).
